source_text: To avoid conflict with other traffic
scope: eight unselected exact CPU bundles, synthetic saved v1 positive/negative package diagnostics; original Native traffic conflict and legal exception unverified

positive_geometry.avoid: source-hashed active actor, positive straight-path body collision frames, zero actual body collision frames, positive bicycle-lane body occupancy

negative_controls: add actor while retaining straight path

fallback_triggers.fallback1: approach runway below 55 m; measured 50 to 60 m
